Order No.03/ Dated:12.07.2024
 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2.  The petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Hussainabad P.S. Case No. 64 of 2024, registered for the offence under Section 376, 313, 427, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4/6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj.

entities.text: Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. As per prosecution case, in the year 2020 informant received a call who introduced himself as Deep Ranjan Kumar, asked her to talk to him and when she denied, he started calling her regularly and lastly finding no other option started talking to him.

It is alleged that in the year 2021 and 2023 petitioner used to call her at Devari Kala Semar Tree and used to make physical relationship with her on pretext of marriage by taking her in a field at Village Budhuwa.
It is further alleged that petitioner continued making physical relationship with her till 2023 on the pretext of marriage.
During the said period she became pregnant and got aborted by administering her medicine.
Thereafter, when the victim started making pressure upon the petitioner to marry her then he started ignoring her.
Lastly she went to the house of the petitoner, then the brother of the petitioner took her mobile phone and broke the sim card and ousted her from there by giving threatening.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all as alleged in the FIR.
The petitioner is languishing in Judicial custody since 22.03.2024 without any rhymes and reasons.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate in the trial of the case by remaining physically present as and when required and shall not indulge in any manner in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the witnesses of prosecution, hence, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

5. Learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of State has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and Deepranjan Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ......Opposite ... on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143611708/
1 submitted that there are sufficient materials against the petitioner showing his involvement in the present case, hence he does not deserve bail.
6.

entities.text: Deepranjan Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is direct allegation against the petitioner that he indulged in sexual intercourse with the minor victim girl and when she got pregnant administered her medicine for termination of her pregnancy.

7. Regard being had to the facts and circumstances of the case and nature of allegation coupled with materials available against petitioner, I am not inclined to release the petitioner, on bail, which stands rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
